name: mRAG-benchmark-scienceqa
description: A benchmark that evaluates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) approaches on the ScienceQA question set, measuring how well retrieval+generation pipelines answer science questions and produce grounded explanations. It is intended to assess improvements from using retrieval components for science-domain question answering.
reputation: A research-oriented dataset used for RAG experiments and ablation studies; modest adoption within the retrieval-augmented LLM community.
